sharedPlatform.title: Shared Platform. Every Product.
sharedPlatform.description: Every Forge product runs on the same foundation — so your data, users, and workflows stay connected as you grow.

productLinesOverview.heroDescription: Forge Public Safety is built for departments, safety teams, and training organizations that need practical software without unnecessary enterprise complexity. Simple to use. Modular by need. Affordable for small and mid-size organizations.

rms.name: Forge RMS

hero.title: Forge RMS
hero.lead: A clean, affordable records management system built for fire departments — without the bloat of large enterprise platforms.
hero.body: Personnel, training, certifications, scheduling, apparatus, inventory, incident reporting, and NERIS submission in one simple system your crews will actually use.

whoFor: Departments replacing spreadsheets or clunky legacy RMS
Agencies that need NERIS-ready reporting without enterprise cost

core.title: Everything Starts With the Base Package
core.description: Every Forge RMS account includes the core records management tools your department needs from day one — personnel, training, apparatus, incidents, and NERIS reporting. Build from here with the add-on modules you need.

rms.modulesDescription: Extend the base package with the add-on modules that match your mission. Each one bundles the records, workflows, and reporting your department needs — turn on only what applies.

modules.name: Operations Module
modules.description: Supports field readiness, pre-incident planning, and response preparation.

modules.name: Prevention Module
modules.description: Supports fire inspections, investigations, and code enforcement workflows.

modules.name: EMS Module
modules.description: Supports EMS operations, staffing, supply tracking, and quality assurance.

modules.name: Command Module
modules.description: Gives fire department leadership visibility into operations, staffing, and compliance.

modules.name: Mobile Module
modules.description: Puts core field workflows in the hands of crews on any mobile device.

spotlight.title: The Forge RMS Advantage
spotlight.description: Forge RMS doesn't win on feature count. It wins by being easier to use, faster to train on, more affordable, and built for how departments actually work.
points: Easier to use and faster to train on
Built for small and mid-size departments
Focused on real fire department workflows
spotlight.quote: A battalion chief should be able to run a report, approve training, view staffing, pull an inspection, and check apparatus status — without digging through ten menus.

industrial-safety.name: Forge Industrial Safety

hero.title: Forge Industrial Safety
hero.lead: Safety management software made simple. Mobilize your safety program, save your teams time, and eliminate paper.
hero.body: Since 2011, Forge Safety has helped safety professionals inspect, train, identify hazards, record observations, report incidents, and scan assets — from anywhere, on any device, with preloaded OSHA checklists built in.

core.title: Everything Starts With the Base Package
core.description: Every Forge Industrial Safety account includes the core EHS apps — a truly paperless, digitized platform that captures safety data in the field and turns it into real-time safety intelligence. Build from here with the add-on modules you need.

industrial-safety.modulesDescription: Extend the base package with the add-on modules that match your operation. Each one bundles the records, workflows, and compliance tracking your team needs — turn on only what applies.

modules.name: Safety Training Module
modules.description: Tracks required safety training, renewals, sign-offs, and employee compliance.

modules.name: Inspection & Audit Module
modules.description: Supports routine safety inspections, workplace audits, and corrective action tracking.

modules.name: Equipment & Asset Module
modules.description: Tracks safety equipment, operational assets, and inspection requirements.

modules.name: QR Scan Module
modules.description: Connects QR codes to equipment, machinery, inspections, checklists, and safety records.

modules.name: OSHA & Incident Module
modules.description: Supports internal incident documentation and OSHA-related tracking.

modules.name: Permit & High-Risk Work Module
modules.description: Supports controlled work activities and high-risk job documentation.

modules.name: SDS / HazCom Module
modules.description: Tracks chemical safety information and hazard communication requirements.

modules.name: Contractor Safety Module
modules.description: Manages outside contractors, required documentation, and site safety compliance.

modules.name: Industrial Command Module
modules.description: Gives safety leadership visibility into safety performance and compliance.

spotlight.title: Trusted Since 2011
spotlight.description: A comprehensive solution to improve safety compliance and engage your employees — capture data digitally, find trends fast, and build safety intelligence from anywhere, anytime.
points: Minimize risks and increase OSHA compliance
Trend and analyze data to drive safety improvement
Get immediate feedback with real-time data
spotlight.quote: Forge Safety saved us potentially thousands of dollars in OSHA penalties, due to the detailed information and the increase in inspections supporting our defense.
spotlight.quoteAuthor: Travis Scott, Scott and Murphy, Inc.

academy.name: Forge Academy

hero.title: Forge Academy
hero.lead: Built for fire academies, EMS education programs, industrial safety training centers, and department training divisions.
hero.body: Manage students, instructors, classes, skills, testing, certificates, and training records in one clean system.

core.title: Everything Starts With the Base Package
core.description: Every Forge Academy account includes the core tools to run students, courses, and training records from day one. Build from here with the add-on modules you need.

academy.modulesDescription: Extend the base package with the add-on modules that match your program. Each one bundles the records, workflows, and reporting your academy needs — turn on only what applies.

modules.name: Course Management Module
modules.description: Manages course catalogs, class rosters, registration, and completion tracking.

modules.name: Student Records Module
modules.description: Tracks each student from enrollment through skills, testing, and certification.

modules.name: Instructor Module
modules.description: Manages instructor profiles, assignments, evaluations, and skill sign-offs.

modules.name: Skills Validation Module
modules.description: Supports practical skill evaluations, sign-offs, and remediation tracking.

modules.name: Testing Module
modules.description: Tracks written and practical testing, scores, and completion rules.

modules.name: Certificate Module
modules.description: Generates, stores, and tracks certificates with renewal and verification.

modules.name: Academy Scheduling Module
modules.description: Coordinates class calendars, instructors, rooms, props, and training grounds.

modules.name: Agency / Department Portal
modules.description: Gives sponsoring agencies access to rosters, training history, and certificates.

modules.name: Academy Command Module
modules.description: Gives academy leadership visibility into enrollment, performance, and reporting.

spotlight.title: Agency Portals & Certificate Tracking
spotlight.description: Give sponsoring departments and agencies their own login to view rosters, training history, and certificates — while your academy manages skills, testing, and completion in one place.
points: Agency logins to view sponsored students and records
Automated certificate generation, storage, and renewals
Skill sheets and practical sign-offs from any device
Written and practical testing with completion rules
Enrollment and performance dashboards for leadership
